test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Advanced Full Test - 04
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left of :: is the same as that on the right side of ::?

# : FTB :: LDK : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d16e50abe1a866069dc7ff61c99f97f83c1c43a73bc7da4d0c011f370fc1dfe.png] 

The logic followed here is :- (2) is multiplied with the position value according to English alphabetic series.

​So,

 
• # = CAJ , % = XHV ⇒ CAJ : FTB :: LDK : XHV

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/82a101bbda1396e7fbc599c4072e48ba2897e3ff7fc35d9eca47b9d31eb59102.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/37901ef9c147d84d6e9caa30a53245a0b8dda824bd168ab469ccdfa64670d121.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = CJA , % = XHV ⇒ CJA : FTB :: LDK : XHV 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d266dcb1030d12879930bd32cc2228ef62cfc7cc5a0c4a57666ba3727d87bc3a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/011e94d465fa80bc61509fab1e5baeb324ffaeb45dfb3b5f4ca302d1e38b0ae8.png] 

**⇒Here, similar pattern can be seen.**

 
• # = JCA , % = XVH ⇒ JCA : FTB :: LDK : XVH

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/56f82cf848c820c837aa06a5c7c86486c7adf22a89413c5982e5d4930d1c2e42.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57d6a7250d1db7a7406983592e1272c86e8925c6f6ca63936b7da09b29388aa9.png] 

⇒Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

 
• # = CJA , % = HXV ⇒ CJA : FTB :: LDK : HXV​ 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b951220018afa22b184a63189c904d1017cffe2dc1e8cf8bebb717efdab6754a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5e26a2b2fd56065c91e6af1ced880f331771c9e77056601afb2ab83d0ccd1bc6.png] 

 

⇒ Here, no similar pattern can be seen.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (2)".
